newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan plans to auction government bonds in March.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan plans to auction government bonds in March.

text.p: Taiwan's finance ministry said on Thursday it would auction an unspecified amount of government bonds in March to ease the government's financial burden.
The ministry would announce exact amounts for the auction at a later date, Chang Hsiu-lien, head of department of national treasury under the ministry, told reporters.
Chang said the ministry also was considering issuing treasury bills in late February depending on the state's funding situation. She gave no further details.
